reviews.review:
All I can say is, I really enjoyed this game alot, even the MP (it's primerly a SP),  if you'r a fan of 40k I recomend it,

(another tip,  dont get  the game "eternal crusade" though, it's like a Indie Crappy version of this game.)
Awesome game. I hope for a sequel.

This is one of the best WH40k games ever made.  It plays very well and really captures the feeling of being a space marine in battle.  Assault, Tactical and Devestator marines are balanced very well, and each plays just perfectly according to its class.  

If you like 40k - you'll absolutely love this game.

Poorly designed overall, poor gameplay, a lot of focus on throwing overwhelming numbers are you. The online mode is basically dead, you can't really get through the scenario's with just yourself and another inexperienced person, and given the lack of activity online the experience rates to get through the levels are blatantly unreasonable. I did not purchase this so that I could be used as a punching bag for the first 20 hours of online play before I can finally unlock the Customizer and actually have cool characters with cool thats which are actually CAPABLE OF SURVIVING. Immensely frustrating, not rewarding, not fun. On top of these issues, the game suffers from the interface design of a first year intern. You can't check your full mouse and keyboard keymap from ingame, it has to be checked and changed from the main menu. Consiquently, if you forget any control you need to know, you must abandon the campaign back to your last checkpoint in order to check that control.

And god forbid you start trying to play in multiplayer, and you need to, oh say, check which key it is to actually chat with eachother? Pressed damn near every key on the keyboard and I couldn't figure it out, did I go back to the main menu to check? Well no, 2 on horde matchmaking was sucking hard, 2000 xp a run was sucking really really hard for progression, and when I requed it ended up with me and another completely different person, when the last guy was probably still wanting another match. I don't even know, this is just broken, just don't buy it.

Edit - Update for 2024 post Space Marine 2 launch, this game is now so broken it won't even launch at all. It hangs on the splash screen for all time, and no troubleshooting method I've found fixes the problem. Steam still won't offer a refund for this pile.
